name: speakr-blog-pipeline
description: End-to-end thought-leadership content pipeline. Smart GDrive onboarding (knows Speakr's canonical folder structure: Brand Blueprint, IP STACK, Branding book, Competitive Analysis, Blogs, Testimonials, Keynotes — pulls and parses each into the right destination). Recurring drive-sync skill refreshes voice DNA as clients add content. Voice always wins over formatting rules. Blog flow: strict text → graphics → preview → publish ordering with styled HTML preview and auto-publish to Webflow/WordPress. LinkedIn flow: conversational, human posts and carousels via linkedin-post-creation (no SEO, no formulaic rehooks, prior-work check, truth-tier tagging). Per-colleague client isolation.
